name.description: Combo name, as `bothways combo` and gc report it; never a variant argument.

variants.description: The variants merged, in merge order.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the read-only, detached worktree.

base_tip.description: Base commit the variants were merged onto.

created_at.description: When the combo was built, RFC 3339 in UTC.

id.description: Decision id, the part before '=' in a variant name.

question.description: The question the variants answer; may be empty.

default.description: Id of the variant whose nested decisions get worktrees. Nothing is ever picked automatically: the default only decides which branch of the tree is materialized. Dropping the default makes the first remaining variant the default.

under.description: The variant this decision is stacked on, or null when it forks from base_branch.

created_at.description: When the decision was forked, RFC 3339 in UTC.

parent_branch.description: The branch sync rebases this decision's variants onto: base_branch, or the branch of the variant named in under.

deferred.description: True when some ancestor variant is not its decision's default: the variants exist as branches but have no worktrees until that ancestor is picked or becomes the default.

post_commit.description: True when the bothways post-commit hook is installed.

path.description: Absolute path of the installed hook file.

binary.description: Absolute path of the bothways binary the hook runs.

binary_ok.description: False when that binary is gone: the hook then only logs that it skipped. Rerun `bothways init --hooks` to record the current one.

chained.description: A post-commit hook that existed before install, kept and run after ours; restored by `bothways init --no-hooks`.

log.description: Absolute path of the log hook-triggered syncs write to.

at.description: When the pick happened, RFC 3339 in UTC.

mode.description: How the repository previews variants: start (bothways supervises a local server per slot), deploy (a script deploys an environment and prints its URL), or none (no preview configured).

pid.description: Process id, and process group, of a start-mode preview.

url.description: Where the preview answers; absent while down.

started_at.description: When the preview was last started or deployed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

log.description: Absolute path of the preview's log file; read it when state is failed.

state.description: up: the URL is serving (start mode passed its health check, or the deploy script printed the URL). starting: the server or deploy script runs but has not answered yet. down: no preview, and the slot is free. failed: the health check or deploy script failed; error says why and log has the output.

error.description: Why the preview failed; present only when state is failed.

branch.description: Where the variant's branch was renamed to, under bothways/rejected/.

at.description: When the variant was rejected, RFC 3339 in UTC.

id.description: Variant id, unique within its decision.

base_tip.description: Commit of the decision's parent_branch this variant was last forked or synced onto.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree where the variant is edited and committed; empty while the variant is deferred or reclaimed.

slot.description: Preview budget slot the variant holds while its preview is not down; absent otherwise.

preview.description: The preview behind the variant's URL as it is right now: a recorded process that has died reads as down.

notes.description: Notes recorded with `bothways note`, oldest first.

state.description: Lifecycle state. idle: the worktree exists and nothing is in progress (a running preview shows in preview.state). conflict: a sync stopped mid-rebase in the worktree; finish the rebase there (git add, git rebase --continue) and the next command reports idle; pick refuses the variant until then. deferred: nested under a non-default variant, so there is no worktree (see the decision's deferred). missing: the recorded worktree directory or the branch is gone; `bothways doctor` repairs the record. reclaimed: gc removed the idle worktree to stay under max_disk; the branch is intact and `bothways sync` rebuilds the worktree.

sync_onto.description: Present only in conflict: the parent commit the stopped rebase is heading to; it becomes base_tip once the rebase is finished.

setup_fingerprint.description: Internal: identifies the setup last run in the worktree, so it reruns when the setup changes.

name.description: <decision>=<variant>: how every command addresses this variant.

default.description: True for its decision's default variant (shown as * in status). Only the default variant's nested decisions have worktrees; it is never picked automatically.

tip.description: Commit the variant branch points at now; empty if the branch is gone, and state is then missing.

ahead.description: Commits on the variant since base_tip: the work that makes it different.

behind_base.description: Commits the decision's parent_branch gained since base_tip. Greater than 0 means the variant is stale and needs `bothways sync` (pick syncs on its own).

schema_version.description: Version of this contract; a reader built for this schema must refuse any other value.

base_branch.description: The branch top-level decisions fork from and pick fast-forwards.

base_tip.description: Commit base_branch points at now; empty if the branch does not exist yet.

decisions.description: Open decisions, every parent listed before the decisions nested under its variants.

picked.description: Decisions already settled by pick, oldest first.

rejected.description: Variants that lost a pick or were dropped; their branches stay under bothways/rejected/ until gc removes them, so a reversed decision is recoverable.

combos.description: Read-only worktrees merging several variants on top of the base, for trying them together. Combos are not variants: nothing may be committed in them, and a combo name is never an argument to sync, pick or drop.

hooks.description: Whether `bothways init --hooks` installed the post-commit hook. While it is installed, a commit on base_branch starts sync in the background, so variants restack without anyone running sync.

title: bothways status --json, schema_version 1
description: Output of `bothways status --json`: the one JSON view of bothways state, shared by the CLI, the compare page and SKILL.md. Fields are only ever added, so ignore the ones you do not know; schema_version changes only with an incompatible change. Paths are absolute, or empty when there is none; times are RFC 3339 in UTC; commits are full hex object names.
